# Documents of testdata/mistakes (tools/mjml-reference/mistakes.mjs) that safe-mjml renders without an error
# but differently from MJML 5.4.1, checked by TestAuthorMistakes. Format: name: reason.
# Remove a line when the document matches MJML or safe-mjml refuses it.

austin-buttons--no-close-mj-button: an ending tag left open before a sibling of the same name in the same parent: MJML keeps the sibling's close tag (</mj-text>) as written in the content, safe-mjml leaves it out; a client displays the same (an HTML parser ignores that close tag)
austin-social-media--no-close-mj-social-element: an ending tag left open before a sibling of the same name in the same parent: MJML keeps the sibling's close tag (</mj-text>) as written in the content, safe-mjml leaves it out; a client displays the same (an HTML parser ignores that close tag)
austin-two-column-text--no-close-mj-text: an ending tag left open before a sibling of the same name in the same parent: MJML keeps the sibling's close tag (</mj-text>) as written in the content, safe-mjml leaves it out; a client displays the same (an HTML parser ignores that close tag)
mj-class-tag-defaults--no-close-mj-text: an ending tag left open before a sibling of the same name in the same parent: MJML keeps the sibling's close tag (</mj-text>) as written in the content, safe-mjml leaves it out; a client displays the same (an HTML parser ignores that close tag)
mj-navbar--no-close-mj-navbar-link: an ending tag left open before a sibling of the same name in the same parent: MJML keeps the sibling's close tag (</mj-text>) as written in the content, safe-mjml leaves it out; a client displays the same (an HTML parser ignores that close tag)
